text: hep global GmbH is based in Güglingen and registered at Amtsgericht Stuttgart, HRB 737 065. In its September 2026 management announcement, Martin Vogt thanks 'our founders, Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle, as well as the other shareholders (Gesellschafter)'. Register publications name hep global holding GmbH as its shareholder; the holding company was registered in 2022 with Thorsten Eitle and M. Hamann as managing directors.
short: hep global GmbH (Güglingen) was founded by Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle; the register names hep global holding GmbH as its shareholder.
